subject: Helio: seller tax evidence and split-billing routing plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Helio Marketplace - Tax Ops <taxops@heliomarket.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seller tax evidence and routing for marketplace fees

Hi —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we discussed, we need to confirm Helio Marketplace's tax expectations so we can set up split routing for: (1) marketplace commission invoiced to Helio (Redwood as service provider to Helio), and (2) seller payouts where Helio acts as the marketplace and may self-bill sellers.

Two asks to move forward:
- Can you confirm Helio's requirement for seller-side evidence (VAT registration or seller declaration) for rev-charge handling and self-bill?
- Please attach the seller VAT certificate(s) you expect to rely on for the June settlement cycle.

Ben and Karthik — looping you in for finance and tax routing. The immediate decision from finance is whether we treat the marketplace commission as reverse-charge (Helio as recipient) or standard B2B VAT. If Helio will accept reverse-charge, we need a signed seller declaration or the seller's VAT cert for each EU seller in the first settlement.

Target timeline: we need confirmation + docs by Tuesday (2026-06-16) to avoid delaying the 30 June payout.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: RBC-product-onepager.pdf (pdf, 38KB)]

From: Helio Marketplace - Tax Ops <taxops@heliomarket.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Marketplace - Finance <finance@heliomarket.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller tax evidence and routing for marketplace fees

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Attached is our standard VAT certificate template for sellers and a recent extract for our main EU seller cohort. In short: Helio expects marketplace commissions to be treated under reverse-charge for EU-to-EU B2B sales when the buyer (Helio) is VAT-registered. For seller payouts, Helio prefers to self-bill sellers where possible; that requires a signed seller declaration confirming their VAT status.

Attachments:
- heliomarket-vat-cert.pdf (PDF, 120KB) — sample seller VAT certs
- seller-list-extract.csv (CSV, 55KB) — note: contains masked VAT numbers for privacy

We can also run an on-the-fly VAT ID validation via Stripe Tax and share the result feed if Redwood can accept a signed API ingestion agreement.

Best,
Helio Tax Ops
Helio Marketplace
[Attachment: heliomarket-vat-cert.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Seller tax evidence and routing for marketplace fees

Marissa / Karthik —

Reviewed Helio's attachments. Quick summary and recommended routing for Finance approval:

1) Marketplace commission (what Helio pays Redwood):
   - Treat as reverse-charge for EU buyers where Helio provides a VAT ID (Helio is buyer/recipient). We will validate Helio's VAT ID and log the proof in our billing system.
2) Seller payouts (what we remit to sellers via Helio):
   - Helio will self-bill sellers. We need either (a) seller VAT cert + signed seller declaration (preferred), or (b) Helio confirmation that they will assume tax liabilities and provide indemnity.
3) Technical flow:
   - Option A: Redwood ingests Helio's masked seller list + Stripe Tax validation feed.
   - Option B: Helio pushes proofs to our secure S3 drop; Finance triggers a manual validation job for the first two months until automation is in place.

Risks / open items:
- If Helio cannot provide seller declarations for a subset of sellers, we need to hold those lines in suspense (delay payout) or invoice with VAT applied.
- Need legal sign-off on indemnity language if Helio wants Redwood to rely solely on Helio-provided proofs.

Please confirm which technical option Helio prefers. If we go with Option B (manual secure drop), we can meet the June 30 settlement but will need a one-off exception from Accounting to process reconciliations next week. Laura — can you confirm Accounting can accept a manual validation cutoff Friday 2026-06-18?

Ben
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Helio Marketplace - Finance <finance@heliomarket.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seller tax evidence and routing for marketplace fees

Hi Ben / Marissa —

Quick follow-up: Helio can provide a signed seller declaration for the EU sellers in scope and confirm UK-established sellers separately. We attached a sample signed declaration (seller-declaration.docx). For the Stripe Tax feed, we can provide read-only API keys scoped to VAT validation only.

We prefer Option A (automated Stripe Tax validation) long-term, but for June settlement we'll push the signed declarations to the secure S3 drop by end-of-day 2026-06-18.

On the indemnity: Helio is comfortable signing a standard MOP (marketplace operating agreement) clause that states Helio will be responsible for seller VAT for the periods they self-bill; we'll sign via DocuSign once Redwood shares the envelope.

Regards,
Helio Finance
[Attachment: seller-declaration.docx (docx, 24KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Helio Marketplace - Finance <finance@heliomarket.com>, Helio Marketplace - Tax Ops <taxops@heliomarket.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final: self-bill docs received and DocuSign for MOP clause

Thanks — this is perfect. Next steps we will execute today:

- Redwood Legal will add the indemnity clause to the MOP and send a DocuSign envelope to Helio (link below).
- Helio will upload signed seller declarations to the secure S3 drop (per Option B fallback) and provide the Stripe Tax read-only key for automated validation.
- Laura / Accounting: please approve the one-off manual validation window so we can release the June 30 settlement for sellers with complete proofs. We will hold any lines that do not have proof and mark them as "suspense" in the invoice.
